newsitem.title: SPAIN: Kohl awarded Prince of Asturias prize.
newsitem.headline: Kohl awarded Prince of Asturias prize.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl has been awarded Spain's Prince of Asturias international co-operation prize, the jury said on Friday.

Kohl, who has headed the German government since 1982, was instrumental in helping reduce conventional arms and destroying medium-range missiles in Europe in the 1980s, the 11-member jury said in a statement.
Kohl campaigned for German unification and is now a decisive force behind economic and monetary union in Europe, it added.
Kohl is the second German award winner following his former Foreign Minister Hans Dietrich Genscher in 1990.
The Prince of Asturias prize was founded in 1980 and named after the Spanish royal heir. Winners receive a statue by Catalan artist Joan Miro, a certificate and a cash prize.
